Drive onto the walls

Hold W or RT/R2 as you approach a curved ramp. Keep accelerating to climb. A/D or the left stick steers along the wall; jump pushes you away from it.

Try your first aerial

Jump, hold S to tilt your nose up, then boost. W tilts your nose down. Use A/D to turn, Q to air roll left and E to air roll right. Land on your wheels to reset your jumps. If you land on the roof, press jump to flip back over.

YOUR OBJECTIVE

Street: accelerate, brake, steer. Race: your arena jump, boost and air-roll binds. Camera: right stick or touch look pad.
CINDER BAY FESTIVAL / FREE ROAM

Choose your next rivalry

Events are available from the start. Drive to their signs, or choose one here. Race with three CPU opponents; difficulty changes their pace, time limits and prizes.

Controller: left stick up/down selects event; left/right changes difficulty; Cross/A starts. Keyboard: Tab to an event, Enter to start. Roads use normal handling; races and Flight School use arena jump, boost and air roll.
